definitions: To apply quantum theory to; to treat in terms of quantum mechanics.
To restrict the possible values of (a physical quantity) to a discrete set, by applying the principles of quantum mechanics.
To divide into discrete quanta or units.
To adjust the timing of (a series of musical notes or other events) to a regular rhythm or grid.
examples: The software can quantize the drum track.
They tried to quantize the field.
You can quantize the MIDI data to correct timing errors.
pastTenses: quantized (simple past), quantized (present perfect), quantized (past perfect)
